automationForm.setRankingsPublishedHint: Controls the ranking inside the participant app: the award-ceremony reveal. Showing it also broadcasts the current standings to all connected teams. Note: showing it opens the public scoreboard at the same time, even without that action.
automationForm.setPublicRankingsEnabledEnable: Enable — outsiders can fetch the standings
automationForm.setPublicRankingsEnabledDisable: Disable — standings no longer publicly fetchable
automationForm.setPublicRankingsEnabledHint: Controls the public scoreboard API for consumers outside the app, such as a big screen or the website. Changes nothing for teams in the app. Note: while the ranking is shown to participants the public scoreboard stays open — disabling it has no effect then.

copyAutomations.title: Copy automations
copyAutomations.description: Copies all automations from another game to this game. Team selections are cleared (apply to all teams), checkpoints are matched by location, and the distance points rate is copied.

copyZones.title: Copy zones
copyZones.description: Copies all zones from another game to this game. Opening and closing times are shifted to this game's timeline, and the hidden-from-teams setting is preserved. Zones with an already-existing name are skipped.

iosInstall.heading: Hey iPhone user, we'd like to send you notifications!
iosInstall.body: On an iPhone you can only receive notifications if you first add the app to your home screen and then open it from there. This keeps you informed of important messages during the rally.
iosInstall.step1Safari: Tap the share icon at the top right
iosInstall.step1Other: Tap the three dots at the bottom right, then tap the share icon
iosInstall.step2: Choose "Add to Home Screen" and confirm with "Add".
iosInstall.step3: Open the Vlettenrally app from your home screen and check in there.
iosInstall.failNote: Can't add it? You can also continue checking in here, but you won't receive notifications on this device.
iosInstall.inviteNote: Joining a team with a QR code? Add the app to your home screen first, open it from there, and then tap "I have an invite QR". Scanning the code with your camera app would open it outside the app, where notifications don't work.
